value.rationale: A physically motivated inverse question in non-Markov switching traps is answered at full-law and bounded-moment observation levels. One calibrated clock suffices for exact identifiability, yet finite-even-moment data and even a separately measured mean can never guarantee identification; explicit construction works at every depth. This distinguishes a principled information boundary from mere numerical reconstruction and complements the already established forward moment hierarchy.
